findings.claim: New observation on 2cb3e0d1, outside the decision's literal condition. The new branch uses report-wide counts: it fires only when the whole control report has a failed test file, no failed assertion and zero passed assertions. If a learner keeps a correct test in starter/src/service-form.test.jsx and adds a second test file under starter/src that fails to load only under the check, the control report has one failed file with no assertion results plus one passing assertion in the other file, so the branch is skipped and npm test prints the unchanged-copy message, exit 1, not the general unreadable-form message. Observed on macOS (darwin), Node 24.2.0 and npm 11.3.0, in a 0700 scratch copy made with git archive of 2cb3e0d1 (2cb3e0d1a7057d24d12a8f87d1d16467a997b891), with the private overlay copied over the starter, npm ci in tests/ and TMPDIR pointed at a private scratch directory. Learner tests were the overlay's reference test and probes I derived from it in scratch, not independently written tests. The probe was the reference test plus a second learner test file holding the learner-side load-failing guard described under edu-fcc-x1; the normal run showed 'Tests 9 passed (9)', the control report showed numFailedTestSuites 1, numTotalTests 1 and numPassedTests 1, and no marker string was printed. The output is learner-safe (exit 1, no weak test accepted, suite error hidden). With the 284d8903 verifier swapped into scratch the same probe got the same unchanged-copy message, so it is not a regression. README task 8 names one test file (starter/src/service-form.test.jsx) and allows splitting the scenario into more than one test, not into more than one file, so the realistic path is uncommon.
findings.recommendation: Accept as a recorded residual for v1; no further correction loop needed. If it is ever wanted, judge the condition per test file (any failed file with no assertion results) rather than report-wide, which stays within the decision's observable requirement. Add the two-file load failure to the private adversarial controls.

Learner tests were the overlay's reference test and probes I derived from it in scratch, not independently written tests. Learner-side load failure: I added to the reference test a module-level guard that throws a distinctive marker string only when the imported default export's source text contains a string literal found only in the Task 8 variant wrapper, so the file loads in the normal run and fails to load under the check. Harness-side load failure: I appended a module-level throw with a second marker string to a scratch copy of tests/task8-variant.jsx and ran the reference test (restored afterwards; sha256 d85eae98... rechecked). Both passed the normal run ('Tests 8 passed (8)') and then npm test printed exactly one Task 8 line, equal byte for byte to the general unreadable-form message, and exited 1. Neither printed the unchanged-copy message, the no-runnable message, 'Vitest said' or either marker string, so the suite error is not exposed. Running the control variant directly for the learner-side probe gave exit 1 and a report with numTotalTestSuites 1, numFailedTestSuites 1, numTotalTests 0 and one test file with status failed and no assertion results, which is the case the new branch matches. With the 284d8903 verifier (sha256 6fe16b97...) swapped into scratch, both probes got the unchanged-copy message instead, so 2cb3e0d1 is what moves them. The reference test is still accepted with the Task 8 line and exit 0. A deleted learner file ('Test Files 7 passed (7)'), a todo-only file ('Tests 7 passed | 1 todo (8)') and a skip-only file ('Tests 7 passed | 1 skipped (8)') still get only the no-runnable message, exit 1. A single test that passes the normal run but has one real failed assertion against the unchanged control (its control report: one failed file whose one assertion has status failed) still gets only the unchanged-copy message, exit 1. A blank-only test gets the four completed-submission messages and a name-only objectContaining check gets only the team message, both exit 1. The outside-form aria-labelledby caption form still gets only the general unreadable-form message, exit 1. Observed beyond the brief: a learner beforeAll hook that throws only under the check left its one test skipped in a failed file and also got the general unreadable-form message (under 284d8903 it got the unchanged-copy message); that is within the decision's wording. Learner-side reading: the decision's observable requirement is met for both load-failure cases, the suite error is hidden, and the message is the existing one, not a new one. One edge outside the decision's literal condition is raised as edu-fcc-y1. The claim is resolved.
